name: LearningPal
desc: A data-driven learning support system for students and teachers.

cards.name: Project Overview
cards.desc:
**Pain Point:** Students struggle to identify specific learning gaps across topics, while teachers lack aggregated diagnostic data to deliver timely, targeted interventions.

**Solution:** LearningPal is a data-driven learning support platform analyzing quiz performance by topic, pinpointing strengths and weaknesses, delivering personalized feedback and resource recommendations, and enabling teacher intervention logging.

**Roles:**
- **Student:** Takes assessments, reviews topic-level mastery, reads feedback, and accesses recommended materials.
- **Teacher:** Inspects class/student gap analytics, overrides automated grades, manages assessments/resources, and records interventions.
- **Admin:** Approves teacher registrations and oversees system accounts.

cards.name: Tech Stack and Architecture
cards.desc:
**Frontend:** React (SPA), Tailwind CSS for styling, Recharts for analytics data visualization, React Router, Context API for state management.

**Backend:** Java Spring Boot following Controller → Service → Repository layered architecture, Spring Security with stateless JWT.

**Database:** MySQL relational database with JPA/Hibernate ORM and foreign-key constraints.

**Security:** Stateless JWT authentication, BCrypt password hashing, and role-based endpoint authorization.

cards.name: SMART Objectives
cards.desc:
**Core Measurable Targets:**
1. **Student Module:** Students view assessment results and topic progress for 1 pilot subject; ≥90% of student testers find them unassisted.
2. **Gap Analysis Engine:** Automated topic-level analysis weak-topic detection matches teacher-validated results in ≥85% of cases on 30+ student records.
3. **Feedback & Recommendations:** Personalized feedback/resources per gap; ≥80% of student testers rate them helpful, with gap progress tracking.
4. **Teacher Module:** Dashboard with charts and intervention log; ≥90% of teacher testers complete key tasks.
5. **Stretch Usability:** Usability rating ≥4.0/5.0 across study plans, reminders, and ratings.

cards.name: Rules and Decisions
cards.desc:
**Core System Rules:**
- **Grading & Gaps:** In-app quizzes are auto-graded. Teachers can override any grade. Gap analysis always uses the final score (teacher score if present, otherwise auto score).
- **Teacher Signups:** Teacher accounts require explicit Admin approval before they can authenticate.
- **Password Policy:** Passwords require 8 to 72 characters, containing at least one letter and one number.
- **AI Grading Fallback:** Essay AI grading is nice-to-have. Core system functions independently. AI scores remain "pending teacher review"; failures route to a manual grading queue.

cards.name: Git Workflow
cards.desc:
**Branching & Code Quality:**
- **Main Branch:** Protected; contains reviewed, stable, working code only.
- **Feature Branches:** Each member creates a personal branch (e.g., `feature/name-task` or `name/dev`).
- **Pull Requests:** Open a PR to merge into `main` with at least one peer code review.
- **Secrets Management:** NEVER commit secrets or local build outputs. Keep `application.properties`, `.env`, `node_modules/`, and `target/` in `.gitignore`.

cards.name: Definition of Done
cards.desc:
**Standard for Completion:**
A user story or task is marked Done when:
1. It functions end-to-end according to acceptance criteria.
2. It is manually verified and unit-tested where applicable.
3. Zero secrets, API keys, or credentials are committed.
4. Code complies with formatting and architectural guidelines.
5. Peer code review is completed and approved on GitHub.
6. Branch is cleanly merged into `main`.

cards.name: [P0] Notebook-themed landing page (React + Tailwind)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Build a clean, welcoming landing page styled with a notebook aesthetic using React and Tailwind CSS.

**Acceptance Criteria:** The page displays product highlights, role overviews, and navigation buttons to login/signup. Responsive on mobile and desktop viewports.

cards.name: [P0] Signup/login backend (JWT, BCrypt, role-based security, CORS)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Implement secure authentication in Spring Boot using JWT, BCrypt, and Spring Security.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Issues signed JWT tokens upon valid credentials. Enforces role-based endpoint permissions (Student, Teacher, Admin) and configures CORS headers.

cards.name: [P0] Signup/login frontend (Login, Signup, AuthContext, ProtectedRoute)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Build client-side authentication screens, state management, and route protection.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Users can sign up and log in. Tokens are stored securely. Protected routes redirect unauthorized users to the login screen.

cards.name: [P0] Password rule: at least one letter and one number (backend and frontend)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Enforce password complexity rules across both client and server.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Passwords must be 8–72 characters and contain at least one letter and one number. Invalid attempts return clear, actionable feedback.

cards.name: [P0] Admin approval for teacher signups (admin seed account, pending list, approve/reject, admin page)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Restrict teacher logins until approved by an administrator.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Teachers sign up with status PENDING and cannot log in. Admins can view pending teachers, approve or reject them, and see an updated roster. Seed initial admin account.

cards.name: [P0] Set up repo, branches, and .gitignore (no secrets)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Initialize project repositories, git branches, and ignore rules.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Repo is structured for frontend and backend. Secrets, build folders, and environments are ignored. Branching policy documented in README.

cards.name: [P0] React Router and frontend folder structure
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Structure the React application with clean folder hierarchy and declarative client routing.

**Acceptance Criteria:** React Router v6 configured with modular paths for landing, auth, student, teacher, and admin layouts.

cards.name: [P0] Mock data (JSON shaped like the future API responses) and service layer
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Provide mock JSON services enabling frontend development ahead of backend integration.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Frontend service modules return realistic JSON mock responses mirroring final API schema for assessments, results, gaps, and resources.

cards.name: [P0] Spring Boot project setup and MySQL connection
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Initialize Spring Boot application with MySQL connectivity and JPA configuration.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Spring Boot starts cleanly, connects to local/Docker MySQL, and executes database health checks without errors.

cards.name: [P0] Database schema design (users, subjects, topics, assessments, questions, results, resources, interventions)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Design relational database schema supporting users, topic hierarchy, testing, analysis, and interventions.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Entity models and SQL migration scripts define all core tables with proper primary keys, foreign keys, and indexes.

cards.name: [P0] API contract: list of endpoints and JSON shapes shared by frontend and backend
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Standardize API contracts and DTO shapes between frontend and backend teams.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Comprehensive API documentation detailing HTTP methods, URL routes, request payloads, response schemas, and status codes.

cards.name: [P1] Student dashboard
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Build the primary student landing view summarizing progress and recent assessments.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Displays quick stats, recent quiz scores, active topic alerts, and navigation links. Meets Objective 1 navigation clarity.

cards.name: [P1] Assessments list
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Display available, in-progress, and completed assessments for the pilot subject.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Students can filter by status and view topic tags, duration, question count, and past score badges.

cards.name: [P1] Take assessment (multiple-choice)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Provide an intuitive quiz-taking interface for multiple-choice questions.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Question pagination/navigation, option selection, answer persistence, auto-grading submission, and confirmation dialog.

cards.name: [P1] Results and explanations page
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Show post-assessment score breakdown with detailed answer explanations.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Displays overall score, topic-by-topic breakdown, correct answers, and feedback. Directly supports Objective 1.

cards.name: [P1] Topic progress page
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Render cumulative student mastery across all topics in the pilot subject.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Visual progress bars, mastery level indicators (Strong/Developing/Gap), and links to drill into specific topic details. Ties to Objective 1.

cards.name: [P1] Usability check: students find results without help (90% target)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Conduct usability testing verifying students locate results and progress unassisted.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Objective 1 validation: at least 90% of student testers find assessment results and topic progress without staff intervention.

cards.name: [P2] Define mastery score formula and strength/gap thresholds
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Establish mathematical formulas and threshold constants for gap detection.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Formulate weighted topic scoring and clear threshold boundaries (e.g., <70% = Gap, 70-84% = Developing, >=85% = Strength). Documented for implementation.

cards.name: [P2] Implement gap analysis in the Spring service layer
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Code the algorithmic gap analysis engine in Spring service layer.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Aggregates topic scores per student using effective final scores (teacher override if present, else auto score) and categorizes gaps accurately.

cards.name: [P2] Unit tests (JUnit) for the analysis logic
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Ensure comprehensive JUnit test coverage for the gap calculation engine.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Unit tests verify correct categorization across boundary conditions, missing scores, multiple attempts, and teacher override precedence.

cards.name: [P2] Build a validation set of 30+ student records with teacher-labeled weak topics
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Create benchmark ground-truth dataset of 30+ student records with teacher-verified gaps.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Objective 2 dataset: 30+ realistic student performance records with educator-annotated weak topics ready for automated validation.

cards.name: [P2] Measure match rate against teacher labels (85% target)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Run algorithmic gap analysis on validation dataset and compute match accuracy.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Objective 2 validation: automated engine achieves >=85% match rate compared against teacher-labeled ground-truth records.

cards.name: [P2] Re-run analysis automatically after a teacher grade override
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Trigger real-time gap recalculation whenever a teacher modifies an assessment grade.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Overriding a score immediately re-evaluates the student's topic mastery and updates gap records using the updated teacher score.

cards.name: [P3] Personalized feedback generation per weak topic
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Generate targeted explanatory feedback tailored to each student's specific gap.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Produces clear diagnostic explanations identifying misconception patterns per weak topic, fulfilling Objective 3 prerequisites.

cards.name: [P3] Resource model, tagged by topic and type
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Define and seed the learning resource database entities.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Resource entity stores title, URL, description, topic tag, difficulty, and type (article, video, quiz, practice exercise). Seeded with pilot topic data.

cards.name: [P3] Recommendation matching (gap topic to resources and activities)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Implement matching engine linking identified student gaps to optimal remedial materials.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Automatically pairs each student gap with relevant, prioritized resources and practice exercises ordered by effectiveness.

cards.name: [P3] Topic detail page: feedback, resources, mark as completed
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Build student UI displaying topic-specific diagnostic feedback and recommended materials.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Displays personalized advice, clickable resources, and a toggle enabling students to mark study items as completed. Ties to Objective 3.

cards.name: [P3] Progress tracking per identified gap
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Provide visual progress tracking showing student improvement over time on gap topics.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Objective 3 fulfillment: students can view chronological mastery progression and resolved gap indicators following remediation.

cards.name: [P3] Helpfulness survey for student testers (80% target)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Administer feedback helpfulness survey to student pilot group.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Objective 3 validation: at least 80% of student testers rate personalized feedback and recommended resources as helpful.

cards.name: [P4] Teacher dashboard with class gap chart (Recharts)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Build teacher dashboard featuring class-wide visual gap analytics using Recharts.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Interactive bar/pie charts display topic mastery distribution, highlighting class-wide weak areas. Meets Objective 4 requirement.

cards.name: [P4] Student list with filters and gap flags
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Provide searchable student roster highlighting individuals with critical learning gaps.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Teachers can filter students by name, topic gap, or performance tier and view immediate visual gap warning flags.

cards.name: [P4] Student detail: gaps, progress, intervention history
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Detailed individual student view showing gaps, score trajectories, and logged interventions.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Displays comprehensive student diagnostic profile, topic mastery trends, past quiz attempts, and chronological intervention records.

cards.name: [P4] Grade Review: view auto grades, override with comment
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Create interface for teachers to inspect auto-grades and submit overrides with explanatory notes.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Displays student submission, system auto-grade, editable score input, and required comment field. Overrides update final score.

cards.name: [P4] Interventions: log and monitor
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Enable teachers to record, schedule, and track educational interventions.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Objective 4 core feature: teachers log intervention type (e.g., 1-on-1, remedial group), notes, date, and monitor student post-intervention status.

cards.name: [P4] Assessment manager: question bank with topic tagging, create assessments, record scores per topic
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Teacher tool to manage question bank, author quizzes with topic tags, and review scores.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Teachers create assessments, assign questions tagged by topic, set duration, and view topic-level score distributions.

cards.name: [P4] Resource manager
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Teacher portal to curate, edit, and categorize remedial learning resources.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Teachers can add new learning materials, assign topic tags, designate media types, edit existing entries, or delete outdated links.

cards.name: [P4] Teacher task testing (90% target)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Conduct structured task-based usability testing with educator participants.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Objective 4 validation: at least 90% of teacher testers successfully complete key workflows (viewing charts, overriding grades, logging interventions).

cards.name: [P5] Student endpoints (results, progress, feedback)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Implement Spring Boot REST controllers serving student-facing data.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Endpoints deliver assessment results, aggregated topic mastery scores, and personalized feedback/recommendation payloads for authenticated students.

cards.name: [P5] Teacher endpoints (students, interventions, grading, assessments)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Implement REST endpoints powering teacher analytics, grading, and management.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Endpoints support class analytics, student roster, grade overrides, intervention CRUD, and assessment authoring operations.

cards.name: [P5] Replace mock services with real API calls
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Transition frontend data layers from mock JSON to live Spring Boot REST endpoints.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Axios client configured with JWT interceptors; all UI components consume real backend endpoints cleanly without regressions.

cards.name: [P5] Role-based access rules on all endpoints
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Secure all REST endpoints with explicit role-based authorization guards.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Enforces @PreAuthorize checks. Students cannot access teacher endpoints, unapproved teachers cannot access data, and admin endpoints are isolated.

cards.name: [P5] Error handling and input validation across the API
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Implement global exception handling and robust request DTO validation.

**Acceptance Criteria:** @ControllerAdvice intercepts errors, returning consistent JSON schemas with helpful error messages and accurate HTTP status codes (400, 401, 403, 404, 500).

cards.name: [P6] Rubric manager
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Build teacher interface to create and configure multi-criterion grading rubrics.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Teachers define criteria, descriptions, score ranges, and performance levels used for essay assessment evaluation.

cards.name: [P6] Essay question type and student answer box
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Support free-form essay questions in the assessment engine.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Students can view essay prompts and input long-form answers with word counters, autosave drafts, and submission confirmation.

cards.name: [P6] LLM grading service in Spring (API key kept on the backend, structured JSON output)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Implement backend LLM integration to grade student essays against teacher rubrics.

**Acceptance Criteria:** API keys secured strictly on backend. Service sends prompt and rubric, parsing structured JSON with criterion scores and explanatory critique.

cards.name: [P6] “AI-graded, pending review” status with teacher approve/edit in Grade Review
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Enforce mandatory teacher oversight for all AI-generated essay evaluations.

**Acceptance Criteria:** AI scores receive "AI-graded, pending review" status. Teachers can accept, edit, or reject the AI score before it becomes final.

cards.name: [P6] Fallback manual grading queue when the AI call fails
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Implement resilient error handling routing failed AI evaluations to manual teacher queue.

**Acceptance Criteria:** If LLM request times out, fails, or returns invalid JSON, system routes submission to manual grading queue without breaking student flow.

cards.name: [P6] Open decision: do provisional AI essay scores count toward gap analysis immediately, or only after teacher confirmation?
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Document and resolve policy regarding provisional AI scores in gap calculations.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Team decision documented. Default recommendation: provisional scores are excluded from gap analysis until teacher confirmation to prevent unverified flags.

cards.name: [P7] User testing plan and test scripts
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Prepare comprehensive testing protocol and scripted user scenarios.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Detailed test scripts covering student and teacher journeys, objective verification benchmarks, and observer scoring rubrics.

cards.name: [P7] Usability survey (target average of 4 out of 5)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Deploy comprehensive usability survey to evaluate student and teacher satisfaction.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Objective 5 validation: system achieves an average usability score of >=4.0 out of 5.0 across student and teacher cohorts.

cards.name: [P7] Fix issues from testing
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Prioritize and resolve defects discovered during pilot testing.

**Acceptance Criteria:** All high-severity usability and functional bugs resolved and regression tested prior to final presentation.

cards.name: [P7] Stretch: personalized study plans
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Generate automated weekly study schedules targeted at identified learning gaps.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Students can generate and view a personalized multi-day calendar allocating daily study sessions for their weakest topics.

cards.name: [P7] Stretch: reminders
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Send notification prompts to encourage timely assessment completion and gap review.

**Acceptance Criteria:** In-app notification center alerts students of upcoming quiz deadlines and unfinished remedial recommendations.

cards.name: [P7] Stretch: students rate recommended resources
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Allow students to rate resource usefulness with a 1-5 star rating.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Students can submit 1–5 star ratings on recommended materials; average rating displays to help guide peer remediation.

cards.name: [P7] Stretch: more resource types (videos, notes, practice exercises)
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Broaden resource catalog with rich media types including embedded video and notes.

**Acceptance Criteria:** UI supports embedded YouTube/Vimeo players, PDF/notes viewer modal, and interactive practice drill questions.

cards.name: [P7] Deployment preparation
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Configure production deployment pipelines and environment configurations.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Docker containers created for Spring Boot and React; cloud/production environment properties configured securely without secrets in source control.

cards.name: [P7] Documentation and final presentation
cards.desc:
**Goal:** Finalize academic project report, user guide, and presentation slide deck.

**Acceptance Criteria:** Complete project README, architecture diagrams, objective verification metrics report, and final presentation slide deck.
